_comment: DECLARATIVE default 4-desktop login layout — single source of truth. Captured live from the running KWin/Konsole session on 2026-06-18 (screen 2304x1536, panel 44px → usable 1492px; every split is at the exact half x=1152). Consumed by default-session.nix → default-session-launcher.sh (the engine) + generated Konsole --tabs-from-file files + kwinrulesrc. Edit THIS file to change the layout, never the launcher. Geometry is stored as logical cells (left|right|full); the launcher computes pixels from the LIVE screen geometry at runtime so the layout is resolution-independent and reproducible on any machine.

fallback._comment: Guarantees a crashing/hanging app can NEVER hold the login. The launcher runs as a systemd --user oneshot AFTER graphical-session.target (login is already complete before it starts), each app is spawned detached, and each launch is wrapped in `timeout`. A failed/timed-out launch is logged (and ntfy'd) and the launcher moves on to the next app.

_apps_doc: App registry — the launcher is GENERIC and reads everything here. To add/change an app you edit ONLY this block + reference it from a desktop window by its key. type=konsole gets the tab/title builder (matched for positioning by PID). For every other app: exec=binary, match_class=KWin resourceClass used to find its window for positioning (case-insensitive), fixed_args=always-passed args, arg_mode=how the window's per-instance value is appended: path→args[0], url→url, none→nothing.

windows._comment: 5 monitoring tabs. command:'' opens a titled shell that runs nothing. FILL IN the command per tab to auto-run a monitor (e.g. host_sys-perf → 'btop'). TODO(diego): provide the 5 commands.
